classification.difficultyReason: Infer that cutting removes twice x from both base dimensions, solve the resulting cubic, and enforce the physical domain to reject an algebraic root while retaining two valid boxes.

content.prompt: Four identical squares are cut from the corners of a rectangular sheet of metal $8\text{ cm}\times10\text{ cm}$. The sides are folded up along the dotted lines to form a rectangular box, as shown.

spec.description: Cut sheet with four attached flaps, dashed fold rectangle, equal-cut ticks and overall sheet dimensions. Drawing proportions are illustrative.
spec.mathematics: Original sheet is 10 cm by 8 cm. Each cut square has side x; the folded base is (10−2x) by (8−2x).

spec.description: Right-pointing transformation arrow from the cut sheet to the folded open box.
spec.mathematics: Shows folding, rather than a numerical operation.

spec.description: Perspective open rectangular box with no top face; source-visible rim, wall and base edges, one obscured dashed base edge and height x on the rear-right vertical edge.
spec.mathematics: Height is x, obtained by folding up the flaps. No additional numerical dimensions are supplied.
spec.answerVisibility: Only the supplied height label is visible.

children.label: a
children.prompt: Find an expression for the volume of the box.

answer.worked:
The height is $x$ cm and the base measures $(8-2x)$ cm by $(10-2x)$ cm.
$$\begin{align*}V&=\text{length}\times\text{width}\times\text{height}\\V&=x(8-2x)(10-2x)\text{ cm}^3.\end{align*}$$

children.label: b
children.prompt: Find the side length of the square that should be cut from each corner if the volume is to be $48\text{ cm}^3$.

answer.worked:
$$\begin{align*}x(8-2x)(10-2x)&=48\\4x^3-36x^2+80x-48&=0\\x^3-9x^2+20x-12&=0.\end{align*}$$
Let $P(x)=x^3-9x^2+20x-12$. Test factors of $12$:
$$P(1)=1-9+20-12=0.$$
Therefore $x-1$ is a factor. Long division gives
$$\begin{array}{r|rrrr}&x^2&-8x&+12&\\\hline x-1&x^3&-9x^2&+20x&-12\\&x^3&-x^2&&\\\hline &&-8x^2&+20x&-12\\&&-8x^2&+8x&\\\hline &&&12x&-12\\&&&12x&-12\\\hline &&&&0\end{array}$$
Hence
$$\begin{align*}(x-1)(x^2-8x+12)&=0\\(x-1)(x-2)(x-6)&=0.\end{align*}$$
By the null factor law, $x=1,2,6$. A box requires $0<x<4$, so reject $x=6$. The cut squares must have side length $1$ cm or $2$ cm.

children.label: c
children.prompt: Hence state the dimensions of the rectangular box with this volume.

answer.short: $8\text{ cm}\times6\text{ cm}\times1\text{ cm}$ or $6\text{ cm}\times4\text{ cm}\times2\text{ cm}$.
answer.worked:
For $x=1$, the base dimensions are $10-2(1)=8$ cm and $8-2(1)=6$ cm, and the height is $1$ cm.
For $x=2$, the base dimensions are $10-2(2)=6$ cm and $8-2(2)=4$ cm, and the height is $2$ cm.
Thus the dimensions are $8\text{ cm}\times6\text{ cm}\times1\text{ cm}$ or $6\text{ cm}\times4\text{ cm}\times2\text{ cm}$; both volumes are $48\text{ cm}^3$.
